# HBA modification of HBB-associated phenotypes

## Analysis population

Restrict this analysis to historical individuals with an interpretable primary HBB
genotype, a canonical HBA state and temporally meaningful phenotype measurements.
Report the eligible denominator for Hb, MCV, MCH, HbA2 and HbF separately.

## Model

A primary explanatory model can be written as

$$
Y = \beta_0 + \beta_{HBA} + \beta_{HBB} +
    \beta_{HBA\times HBB} + \gamma^T X + u_{family/person} + \epsilon,
$$

where $X$ includes available age, sex, referral indication, ancestry proxy, iron
status, transfusion/treatment context and measurement timing. Use clustered or
mixed models where repeated measurements or related people are present.

## Computational effect annotations

Use variant-class-specific predictors as secondary evidence: splice models for
splice variants, regulatory models for promoter/enhancer variants and protein or
structure models for coding missense variants. Deletions, gains and hybrid genes
require explicit structural representation rather than a generic protein score.
